cards.ex: I tried to get my point across, but no one seemed to understand.
cards.exUz: Men fikrimni yetkazishga harakat qildim, lekin hech kim tushunmadi shekilli.
cards.uzDef: Bir fikrni yoki xabarni boshqalarga tushunarli qilib yetkazish.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength; it's like we can read each other's minds.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim bir xil fikrdamiz; xuddi bir-birimizning fikrlarini o'qiy olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir-birini yaxshi tushunish.

cards.ex: Communication should be a two-way street; both sides need to listen.
cards.exUz: Aloqa ikki tomonlama bo'lishi kerak; ikkala tomon ham tinglashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro harakat yoki munosabat bo'lishi, ikki tomon ham manfaatdor bo'lishi.

cards.ex: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what you really want.
cards.exUz: Aylanma yo'lni bas qiling va menga nima xohlayotganingizni ayting.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mavzuga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tmasdan, chetlab gapirish.

cards.ex: Drop me a line when you get to London so I know you arrived safely.
cards.exUz: Londonga yetib borganingizda menga xabar yozib qo'ying, xavfsiz yetib borganingizni bilay.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga qisqa xabar yozish yoki qo'ng'iroq qilish.

cards.ex: I heard through the grapevine that they're planning to move to Italy.
cards.exUz: Mish-mishlardan eshitishimcha, ular Italiyaga ko'chib o'tmoqchi ekan.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan manbalardan, mish-mishlar orqali xabar topish.

cards.ex: The restaurant became popular through word of mouth.
cards.exUz: Restoran og'izdan og'izga tarqalgan ma'lumotlar orqali mashhur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir odamdan boshqasiga og'zaki ravishda tarqaladigan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: We had a serious talk to clear the air after the argument.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin vaziyatni yaxshilash uchun jiddiy gaplashdik.
cards.uzDef: Nopok tushunmovchiliklarni bartaraf etish, vaziyatni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: To put it in a nutshell, the project was a disaster.
cards.exUz: Qisqacha aytganda, loyiha falokat edi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani juda qisqa va aniq shaklda aytish.

cards.ex: Even at parties, they always end up talking shop.
cards.exUz: Hatto ziyofatlarda ham ular doimo ish haqida gaplashadilar.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida faqat ish masalalari haqida gaplashish.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what she really means.
cards.exUz: Uning asl ma'nosini tushunish uchun qatorlar orasidan o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aytilmagan narsalarni tushunishga harakat qilish, yashirin ma'noni topish.

cards.ex: I think he finally got the message that I don't want to see him.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, u nihoyat men uni ko'rishni xohlamasligim haqidagi xabarni oldi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani tushunish yoki qabul qilish, ko'pincha yashirin xabarni.

cards.ex: I think you've misunderstood what I was trying to say.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, siz mening nima demoqchi ekanligimni noto'g'ri tushundingiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani noto'g'ri qabul qilish yoki tushunish.

cards.ex: Some jokes are just lost in translation.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi hazillar shunchaki tarjimada yo'qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Bir tilning nozik jihatlari boshqa tilga tarjima qilinganda yo'qoladi.

cards.ex: Let's keep in touch after you move away.
cards.exUz: Ko'chib ketganingizdan keyin aloqada bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda aloqada bo'lish, xabar almashish.

cards.ex: Long story short, we ended up getting lost and arriving late.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, biz adashib qoldik va kech kelib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq hikoyaning qisqacha xulosasi.

cards.ex: It was just a slip of the tongue; I didn't mean to offend anyone.
cards.exUz: Bu shunchaki til xatosi edi; men hech kimni xafa qilmoqchi emasdim.
cards.uzDef: Tasodifan aytib yuborilgan xato so'z yoki ibora.

cards.ex: I was at a loss for words when I heard the news.
cards.exUz: Men bu xabarni eshitganimda nima deyishni bilmay qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Nima deyishni bilmaslik, gapira olmay qolish.

cards.ex: Don't be afraid to speak your mind, even if others disagree.
cards.exUz: Boshqalar rozi bo'lmasa ham, o'z fikringizni aytishdan qo'rqmang.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni ochiq va erkin bildirish.

cards.ex: Let's get straight to the point; we need to discuss the budget cuts.
cards.exUz: Keling, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri asosiy mavzuga o'taylik; biz byudjet qisqartirishlarini muhokama qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri asosiy mavzuga o'tish, aylanma yo'llardan qochish.

cards.ex: I think you're missing the point; it's not about the money.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, siz ma'noni tushunmayapsiz; gap pulda emas.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy ma'noni yoki muhim narsani tushunmaslik.

cards.ex: In other words, we're not going to be able to meet the deadline.
cards.exUz: Boshqacha qilib aytganda, biz muddatga ulgura olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Boshqacha usulda tushuntirish uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

cards.ex: Don't put words in my mouth! I never said that.
cards.exUz: Menga gap to'qima! Men hech qachon bunday demaganman.
cards.uzDef: Birovning so'zlarini noto'g'ri talqin qilish yoki u aytmagan narsani aytgan deb da'vo qilish.

cards.ex: I couldn't say it with a straight face; it was too funny.
cards.exUz: Men buni jiddiy aytolmadim; juda kulgili edi.
cards.term: say it with a straight face
cards.uzDef: Kulmasdan yoki tabassum qilmasdan, jiddiy ohangda aytish.

cards.ex: To be frank, I don't think that's a good idea.
cards.exUz: Ochig'ini aytsam, menimcha bu yaxshi fikr emas.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va to'g'ri so'zlash, haqiqatni yashirmasdan gapirish.

cards.ex: For the record, I disagree with this decision.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumot uchun, men bu qarorga rozi emasman.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy ravishda qayd etish uchun aytilgan so'zlar.

cards.ex: Let's call a spade a spade: this project is failing.
cards.exUz: Keling, haqiqatni ayting: bu loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoqda.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va ochiq aytish, yumshoqlik qilmaslik.

cards.ex: I needed to get something off my chest, so I told her everything.
cards.exUz: Menga nimadir yuragimdan tushirish kerak edi, shuning uchun men unga hamma narsani aytdim.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni bezovta qilayotgan narsani aytib yengillashish.

cards.ex: Her name is on the tip of my tongue, but I just can't remember it.
cards.exUz: Uning ismi tilim uchida, lekin men uni eslay olmayapman.
cards.term: on the tip of my tongue
cards.uzDef: Bir so'zni eslay olmaslik, lekin uni bilish.

cards.ex: Just hear me out before you make a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin meni eshitib ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: Gapimni oxirigacha eshitishni so'rash.
